title: Post-eligibility verification status for the November 1, 2026 Ripple XRP escrow event

prior_explorer_conflict.prior_bithomp_account_page_observation: Displayed no transaction history and no escrow objects for the two accounts.
prior_explorer_conflict.interpretation: Potential stale/incomplete explorer cache or page rendering. Not sufficient to disprove the tracker schedule.

source_evidence.supports: The latest captured schedule, account labels, 1B XRP gross eligibility and prior release/re-escrow history.
Raw ledger account objects, including Escrow objects, must be queried at a specified validated ledger.
An EscrowFinish transaction is required for release; transaction metadata determines the actual result.
A public GET account-transactions endpoint is documented, but the direct API request was inaccessible through the current browser interface.
Prior page observation conflicting with XRP Insights; not revalidated in this run.

access_and_method_limitations: The XRP Insights page returned a validated-ledger observation from 22:18 UTC, before the 00:00 UTC eligibility time.
The official account_objects and account_tx methods are JSON-RPC requests; no raw POST request execution was available in this run.
The XRPSCAN GET API documentation was reviewed, but the direct account endpoint was inaccessible through the browser retrieval path.
Search-engine queries returned no indexed November 1 transaction hash. Search-result absence is not evidence that no transaction occurred.
No private credentials, account keys, or unauthorized access were used.
correction_note: Append-only validator repair copy. Original preserved; ledger pointer redirected to this corrected copy. Source claim and observation unchanged.
